Subject: RE: Norvell Industries Submission

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the Norvell Industries submission. I've reviewed the information and appreciate having everything we need upfront.

I do need to refer this to our senior underwriter before moving forward. The main concern is that the five-year loss history shows incurred losses exceeding $250K, which is above our standard authority level.

I'll present this internally and circle back with you by end of week. In the meantime, if you'd like a faster turnaround, you might also consider reaching out to a specialty carrier, one that may have more appetite for accounts with this loss profile.

I'll be in touch soon.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
